ns2:course.label: Honors Real Analysis
ns2:course.description: A rigorous treatment of basic real analysis via metric spaces. Metric space topics include continuity, compactness, completeness, connectedness and uniform convergence. Analysis topics include the theory of differentiation, Riemann-Darboux integration, sequences and series of functions, and interchange of limiting operations. As part of the honors sequence, this course will be rigorous and abstract. Approved for honors grading. 3 undergraduate hours. Prerequisite: An honors section of MATH 347 or an honors section of MATH 416, and consent of the department.
